entity.summary: Open-source self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning mobile wallet from Synonym with an embedded Lightning node.
entity.notes: Current first-party Bitkit material explicitly describes Bitkit as a fully self-custodial mobile wallet and states the Lightning node runs inside the wallet. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Bitkit open-source self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning mobile wallet.
products.notes: First-party material explicitly distinguishes its embedded Lightning node from custodial wallet architecture.

events.title: Bitkit Android v2.4.0 released
events.description: Synonym released Bitkit Android v2.4.0 with Trezor hardware-wallet support, background-payment reliability improvements, and numerous transfer, notification, widget, and Lightning fixes.

events.title: Bitkit documented native-app rebuild, Wake to Pay, and Bitcoin Maps
events.description: Bitkit announced a major mobile update built on a native-app rewrite, adding Android Wake to Pay for background Lightning receiving and an integrated Bitcoin Maps feature while retaining its LDK-based Lightning node.

evidence.title: What is Bitkit?
evidence.notes: First-party help explicitly calls Bitkit a fully open-source self-custodial mobile Bitcoin wallet combining on-chain and Lightning functionality.

evidence.title: Bitkit
evidence.notes: Current official product page describes Bitkit as a self-custodial Bitcoin wallet and links current mobile distribution.

evidence.title: Bitkit Android v2.4.0
evidence.notes: Official Synonym Bitkit Android release with APK assets and detailed changelog.

evidence.title: What Is New in Bitkit: Native Performance, Wake to Pay, and Bitcoin Maps
evidence.notes: First-party Bitkit article documents the native rewrite, Android Wake to Pay, and integrated Bitcoin Maps.
